mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in monthly employment (PAYEMS) signals a robust labor market, reducing uncertainty and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline in >60% of instances where PAYEMS rises for 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in monthly employment (PAYEMS) above 152,000 signals strong labor demand, reducing uncertainty and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not positive in >50% of triggered instances where PAYEMS crosses above 152,000.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both demand (GDPC1) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals robust economic growth, strengthening equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and INDPRO rise for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.05 over any 6-month rolling window, or 60-day returns are not significantly positive when both proxies rise.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 3.5%), sustained high federal funds rates signal tighter policy, increasing discount rates and compressing equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly negative in >70% of instances where FEDFUNDS remains above 3.5% for 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden surge in industrial production (INDPRO) above 105 signals robust supply chain activity, boosting consumer demand and equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not positive in >60% of triggered instances where INDPRO crosses above 105.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment claims (UNRATE) and housing starts (HOUST) signals strong labor demand and housing market activity, reinforcing equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both UNRATE and HOUST rise for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.04 over any 9-month rolling window, or 60-day returns are not significantly positive when both proxies rise.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in GDP (GDPC1) indicates robust economic growth, boosting corporate earnings and equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly higher than baseline in >75% of instances where GDPC1 rises for 3 quarters.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, sustained growth in industrial production (INDPRO) and GDP (GDPC1) signals peak demand, reinforcing equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both INDPRO and GDPC1 rise for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 18-month rolling window, or 60-day returns are not significantly positive during late-cycle expansions.
